overview: The Wausau Parks & Recreation Committee held a brief reconvening session following a closed session for a quasi-judicial matter. The committee voted to affirm an unspecified motion from closed session and declined to pursue acquisition of a county-owned property on 28th Street for park development.
committee: City of Wausau Parks & Recreation Committee
presiding: Unidentified chair ('Madam chair' referenced in transcript)

agenda.item: Reconvene from closed session — quasi-judicial matter
Motion to affirm closed session quasi-judicial decision
Closed session consideration — county-owned property at 625 N. 28th Street
Committee discussion on interest in purchasing 28th Street property for park development

discussions.body: Upon reconvening from closed session, Alder Neil moved to affirm the quasi-judicial decision and the motion was seconded by Alder Trueblood. The committee approved the motion 4-0 with no opposition noted.

discussions.item: County-owned property at 625 N. 28th Street — potential park acquisition
discussions.body: The committee discussed whether to enter closed session regarding possible acquisition of a county-owned property on 28th Street for park development. Alder Sho stated agreement with Alder Neil that the committee had no interest in purchasing the property, citing the conditional cost of rehabilitating it. Alder Slonsky concurred, saying she saw no reason the city would have interest in purchasing the property for park development. With consensus against pursuing the acquisition, no motion was made and the item was passed over without action.
Alder Trueblood moved to adjourn and Alder Slonsky seconded. The motion passed unanimously on a voice vote.

actionItems: Quasi-judicial closed session decision was affirmed by a 4-0 vote
No action taken on potential acquisition of county-owned property at 625 N. 28th Street — committee consensus was against pursuing purchase for park development
title: Wausau Parks & Recreation Committee Meeting
